decisions.reason: The client explicitly says the footer works well; narrowing the internal-page header content does not change the footer's required content.
The revised internal header does not remove or alter the requirement that customer-specific report fields remain editable.
The header refinement does not determine how the separate vehicle-identification section must display the vehicle group or assessed vehicle.
A subtle, space-efficient internal header is consistent with the existing visual direction and does not require any change to the broader visual-theme state.
The source change applies to pages 2 onwards and does not alter the front-page score panel, fields, or prominence.
The candidate already records the DX-17 internal-header identifier from the same message, and the source header refinement introduces no additional identifier change.
The internal-page header change does not affect the content or presentation of result drivers on the front page.
Including 'Confidential' in the internal header does not modify the independently required final-page limited-distribution warning.
Removing the internal header's former information list does not change the separate policy for assessment-date placeholder copy.
The internal header refinement does not change which reusable fonts, icons, or design assets must be included in the final package.
The internal-page header content and presentation do not alter the scoring-summary table or its required fields.
Using DX-17 in the example header does not remove or modify the required DX17–DX20 variant set.
